data.narrative: The student demonstrated exceptional distributed systems mastery across asynchronous queue architecture, worker decoupling, and exact-once idempotency semantics in Module 07. They architected a resilient Redis-backed background worker queue, instituted storage-engine UNIQUE index deduplication eliminating at-least-once retry risks, integrated privacy-preserving salted SHA-256 IP hashing, and flawlessly diagnosed an idempotency bypass bug during the incident triage phase.

dimension_scores.observation: Analyzed synchronous vs asynchronous queue processing for high-throughput click tracking, articulating how background workers prevent database connection pool exhaustion under 10k clicks/5s bursts.
dimension_scores.evidence: Chose Option B (async_queue) citing protection of sub-millisecond redirect latency and isolation of heavy User-Agent and GeoIP enrichment.

dimension_scores.observation: Accurately diagnosed the root cause of duplicate click replay to omitted eventId mapping in click.worker.ts, identifying database row inspection and Select-String as fastest checks.
dimension_scores.evidence: Hypothesized that eventId was omitted from prisma.clickEvent.create, inserting NULL and bypassing the unique constraint index, and confirmed with targeted grep.

dimension_scores.observation: Enforced zero-leak privacy standards by replacing raw IP addresses with salted SHA-256 hashes at ingress, and maintained tenant isolation on analytics read queries.
dimension_scores.evidence: Verified 64-character ipHash storage with zero raw IP strings in ClickEvent, and validated Tenant B received HTTP 404 when querying Tenant A analytics.

dimension_scores.observation: Engineered comprehensive fault tolerance: dead-letter queue routing for poison pills, 30-day automated retention pruning, and graceful degradation during broker outages.
dimension_scores.evidence: Verified GET /r/:code continued returning HTTP 302 in 0.81ms during simulated queue outage, and proved automated deletion of 60-day-old click records.

dimension_scores.observation: Articulated at-least-once queue delivery risks, post-commit ACK network boundaries, and storage-engine deduplication with crisp systems-engineering analogies.
dimension_scores.evidence: Clearly structured the distinction between application-level SELECT TOCTOU races and database-level atomic unique index collision handling.

strengths: Exceptional grasp of at-least-once message queue delivery semantics and two-phase network acknowledgment failures.
First-principles incident triage isolating missing database field mapping without guessing.
Rigorous privacy compliance mindset ensuring PII is hashed at the ingress boundary before entering queues or databases.
growth_areas: Apply this same indexing discipline and query optimization in Module 08 when implementing full-text search and complex multi-tenant aggregations.
data.recommendation: Carry forward this asynchronous decoupling and indexing rigor into Module 08 for advanced search queries and tag filtering.
